notes.title: v.2.1.0 - Level update
notes.content:
This new Lead the Way update arrives with a total of 100 new levels (20 in each game mode). Each game mode now has 60 levels.

Enjoy!

notes.title: v.2.0.1 - HotFix
notes.content: Small update to fix the issue where levels wouldn't appear in the right order.

notes.title: #1 - Let's prepare to Lead the Way in April! 😍
notes.content:
Here we are! 💙❤️💚


After months of work, we are happy to announce to you the official release date of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1865940/Lead_the_Way__Full_Collection/]Lead the Way - Full Collection[/url]: April 20th, 2022 🥳

Lead the Way first saw the light of day in September 2021, even before [url=https://theanaproductions.com/]Theana Productions[/url] was truly born (🤯), and since then, it went through a lot of changes and updates. Seeing it on Steam now truly is a sight, and we are all really excited for you to play and discover it! 🤩

The released version will be 2.0.0, and we intend on updating it as often as possible with bug fixes as well as new levels (we plan on adding a total of 100 levels per update until we reach the total level amount we want😎). 


We hope you’ll all love this game as much as we do,
Until next time,
[b]Theana Production’s team[/b] 🥰

[i]PS: Our little blobs are ecstatic about the game release, so don’t forget to follow them on [url=https://twitter.com/leadthewayOff]their Twitter account[/url] 😉[/i]
